description: A null for an optional object attribute missing from a map has a type without optional attributes
notes: The README's convert populates a missing optional attribute with a null of the attribute's type, which as the type of a value is object({b = string}), since only type constraints have optional attributes. The outer conversion to object({a = any}) keeps the attribute as it is. It is there because hashicorp/hcl's inner conversion alone gives the null the type object({b = optional(string)}), which no value can have: go-cty's map to object conversion fills a missing optional attribute with a null of the attribute's type as written (conversionMapToObject in cty/convert/conversion_collection.go), while its object to object conversion removes optional attributes from the types of null attribute values (conversionObjectToObject in cty/convert/conversion_object.go).
